scope: Source-only QA notification event-dispatch proposal; no installation or activation.

review.canonicalAuthorization: Only a private existing notification/call job selects the fixed QA destination and payload. Caller input cannot select a recipient, URL, credential, message or SQL.
review.privilegeBoundary: Private settings/jobs have RLS with no app policies. Narrow public RPCs require both service-only EXECUTE grants and a service role claim.
review.oneUse: A conditional UPDATE atomically consumes a matching unexpired queued capability, with claim-ID-fenced completion. No automatic replay follows uncertainty.
review.currentAuthorization: The existing handler still performs current account, recipient, session, membership, preference and call checks before provider delivery.
review.modeSwitch: Legacy-mode and enabled-state checks occur during enqueue, claim and immediately before forwarding. Terminal acknowledgement remains available while paused.
review.timeout: 45-second pg_net deadline exceeds the30-second dispatch plus3-second completion budget. A transport timeout never authorizes a replay.
review.queueVisibility: The long-lived service credential is absent from the provider queue. Observers can advance only the canonical event; queue writers can still suppress attempts.
review.triggerOrder: Existing aa_call_push_origin precedes notification_call_event_dispatch_queue; actual fixture inserts and group-call creation are covered.
review.confirmation: Retention DELETE remains explicit. Candidate is outside automatic migrations and no alternative bridge or SQL confirmation bypass is used.

deploymentDecision: Retain as an uninstalled reviewed QA candidate. Outstanding migration-connector outcome and hosted acceptance must be resolved before any installation.
limits: At-most-once forwarding can lose an attempt if the worker crashes after claim and before send.
A feature switch cannot retract a request already in progress; delivery-mode changes require draining and inspection.
Synthetic SQL/HTTP boundaries do not establish actual pg_net worker, Edge, provider or device acceptance.
